newsitem.title: USA: Clinton - economy good, no inflation, rates up to Fed.
newsitem.headline: Clinton - economy good, no inflation, rates up to Fed.

text.p: President Clinton said Tuesday the U.S. economy was strong, inflation was low but that it was up to the Federal Reserve Board to decide on the level of interest rates.
"I'm very pleased that we have strong growth and no sign of inflation," he said at the start of a meeting with Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto on the fringes of the U.N. General Assembly.
When asked if the Fed had any cause to raise rates at today's Federal Open Market Committee meeting, he said: "They have to make their decisions. I can't comment on that."
